events.summary: Speaker A stated the new remote control is to be original, trendy and user-friendly.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: The new remote control is to be original, trendy and user-friendly

events.summary: Speaker A set the method: functional design individually with a meeting, then conceptual design, then detailed design.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we'll have a functional design individual work um with meeting

events.summary: Speaker A said the remote will be sold for 25 Euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: we're to sell it for twenty five Euros, with a profit

events.summary: Speaker A stated the aimed profit is 50 million Euros.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: with a profit aim ultimately of fifty million Euros

events.summary: Speaker A said production must cost no more than 12.5 Euros per item.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: the production is to only cost twelve and a half Euros per item

events.summary: Speaker D estimated the mark-up should be more like 60 percent, and asked whether 50 percent is normal.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: I would think would be more like sixty percent

events.summary: Speaker A said the group would have to sell 4 million remotes to make 50 million Euros profit at 12.5 Euros each.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: You'd have to sell four million

events.summary: Speaker A objected to remotes that control more than one device, because they are reported to work poorly together.
events.speaker: A
events.quote: I also have heard about them not working well or not well co-ordinated

events.summary: Speaker C proposed the remote is just for television.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: I presume this is just for television

events.summary: Speaker D proposed a Hello Kitty themed remote.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: We could make a Hello Kitty themed remote

events.summary: Speaker C proposed a remote in bright colours.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: I think one in b bright colours would be good

events.summary: Speaker D proposed a Japanese animation style, citing the reputation of Japanese industrial design.
events.speaker: D
events.quote: We could totally go for the Japan-a-mation

events.summary: Speaker B proposed a remote that works.
events.speaker: B
events.quote: I think one that works would be good

events.summary: Speaker C proposed a remote without lots of superfluous functions, since many buttons are unknown to users.
events.speaker: C
events.quote: I think one that doesn't have lots of superfluous functions

events.summary: Speaker D proposed dropping the number buttons, since channel up and channel down are enough, and using menus for mute and volume.
